f2_adjudication_timing_answer.question: owner pre-adjudication BEFORE the GO, or only at E-phase verdict interpretation?
f2_adjudication_timing_answer.answer: BEFORE the GO (before any scored compute). Gate margins are outcome-shaped (PnL-derived); adjudicating the exactly-2/3 semantics after compute but 'before interpretation' is still outcome-conditioned because the adjudicator would know which reading flips the verdict - rescue-class rule-making under the p3 freeze ('no_threshold_change_after_pnl_visible'). Zero-cost path: owner ratifies the executable strict-inequality semantics as-is in one sentence pre-GO (no code change; conservative default stands and a 2/3-kill remains transparent via margins_to_fail margin 0.0), OR pre-commits the equality-pass reading as a code change landing before any scored compute. Deciding at interpretation time with margins visible is NOT acceptable.
f2_adjudication_timing_answer.binding_case_note: the ambiguity binds only if the anchor lands at exactly 2/3 positive folds with all other gates green; the protocol must still be fixed before outcomes exist regardless of probability
